svg.text: Floor plan
10 x 10 m clear · 8 buttresses · printed walls
Printed wall 400 (= ring beam width = roof base
width). Buttresses solid black: 400 wide (same as
the wall), 700 deep from the inner face (flush with
the wall inside), so they project 300 outside.
Openings, one per bay between the buttresses: doors
1000 (south-west and north-east bays), windows 1800
in the other six. Positions and sizes are
placeholders.
Pyramid roof above (dashed): 1000 square crown, hips
to the corners, roof base 400 thick square to the
slope, so its outer edge lands about 59 outside the
wall face.
Buttresses at the 4 corners and the 4 mid-spans,
axes 5200 apart (centre to centre of wall).
from your sketches
assumed by me, to confirm
Notes
Section A-A cuts through the east and west mid-span
buttresses.
Detail D1 is the eave at the east mid-span buttress.
